T: Some fish stories are true. This dinner is.
D: A son tries to separate fact from fiction in his dying father's tall tales.
P: Serve the mains when Edward tells the story of the giant catfish.
S: the perfect little town with shoes hanging over the road

Soft white bread filled with creamy egg, mayo, chives and white pepper, cut into triangles and laid on a picnic blanket with lemony apple slices. Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Mash with 3 tbsp mayo, chopped chives, salt and white pepper. Spread over 4 slices of soft white bread, top with 4 more and cut off the crusts, then into triangles. Slice 2 apples and toss in lemon juice. Lay it all out on a picnic blanket.
the circus where Edward works for clues about Sandra

Fresh popcorn coated in buttery brown sugar caramel, baked low until glassy and crunchy, tossed with roasted peanuts and sea salt. Pop 100g popping corn in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot and tip into a large bowl with 100g roasted peanuts. Boil 100g butter, 200g brown sugar and 60ml golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in half a tsp bicarb and a pinch of salt so it foams. Pour over and toss. Spread on lined trays and bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15. Cool and break up.
Raw peanuts boiled 2 hours in salted water with Cajun spice, soaked an hour, served warm in paper cones.
M: Whole snapper or barramundi scored, rubbed with Cajun spice and butter, roasted at 200C for 25 minutes, with lemon, hush puppies and coleslaw.
Karl the giant's garlic roast leg of lamb
the giant who eats a whole flock

A whole leg of lamb studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted pink and carved at the table, with crisp roast potatoes and fresh mint sauce. Make small cuts all over a 2kg leg of lamb and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves and sprigs of rosemary. Rub with oil and salt. Roast at 180C to 58C inside, about 1 hour 20 minutes, and rest 20 minutes. Parboil 1.2kg potatoes, rough up and roast in oil for the last hour. Chop a bunch of mint with 2 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp boiling water and 4 tbsp malt vinegar for mint sauce.
W: the field of daffodils for Sandra
Lemon drizzle cake baked at 170C for 45 minutes, soaked with a hot lemon syrup, iced with yellow lemon icing.
K: Edward works three years for the circus

Homemade cherry and vanilla syrup topped with cold soda water over ice, finished with a float of cream and a cherry on top. Simmer 300g frozen pitted cherries with 150g sugar, 150ml water and a split vanilla bean for 10 minutes, mash and strain, then cool. Fill four tall glasses with ice, add 50ml syrup and a squeeze of lime to each and top with 200ml soda water. Pour 2 tbsp cream gently over the top of each and add a cherry.

m.how: Score a 1.5kg whole snapper and rub with Cajun seasoning and 50g butter. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes. Fry hush puppies of 150g cornmeal, flour, buttermilk and egg. Shred a quarter cabbage for slaw. Serve with lemon.

w.note: the field of daffodils for Sandra
w.how: Beat 175g butter with 175g sugar, add 3 eggs and lemon zest and fold in 175g self-raising flour. Bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Soak with hot lemon syrup, then ice with 150g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice and a touch of yellow.
